# SENO Avian Genetics Research Center

> Scientific research knowledge base on avian molecular genetics, bird DNA testing, PCR diagnostics, genome analysis, and racing pigeon genetics.

## What this is

SENO Research Center is the scientific knowledge platform of **Zhangjiakou SENO Testing Center** (张家口塞诺检测中心), an avian molecular genetics research organization specializing in PCR-based bird DNA testing, avian diagnostics, and genetic analysis. Our research covers the CHD gene sex-determination system, qPCR pathogen detection, and racing pigeon genetic markers.

## Full content

For the complete text of every page, read [llms-full.txt](https://research.aviantestpro.com/llms-full.txt).

## Research areas

- **Avian Genetics** — ZZ/ZW sex chromosomes, CHD gene, inheritance patterns
- **Molecular Diagnostics** — PCR, qPCR, DNA extraction, assay validation
- **Bird Genome Research** — genome sequencing, mtDNA, population genetics
- **Racing Pigeon Genetics** — performance markers, DNA fingerprinting, parentage
- **Avian Disease Research** — PBFD, polyomavirus, avian influenza surveillance
- **Laboratory Methods** — sampling, extraction, troubleshooting, quality control
- **Research Database** — CHD gene and STR marker reference data
- **Publications** — peer-reviewed literature with DOI/PubMed IDs
